identity: Since we're stripping you down to flesh and bone you need to survive, we can take the time to salvage your CBMs, and keep it all intact, reinstalled in your new Cyberframe.  But your limbs and other parts will be exchangeable, like bionics.  In the future, if you take off a limb, you'll have to remove your CBMs, fix them, clean them, and reinstall them.

identity:
This floating island is your base of operations, isolated and safe.  When you are ready, use the Warp Obelisk to teleport down to the surface and begin an expedition.  Scavenge, kill, explore, and reach the exit to return here.

Should you die, you will be saved from death and returned to the island, though you will lose EVERYTHING that you were carrying.

Go on expeditions, clear missions, stockpile supplies, upgrade this island, and prepare yourself for your next outing with the equipment you have retrieved.  Repeat until you are an unstoppable force!
Good luck.
